meta.title: Silver — SGGW computer science student club
meta.description: The computer science student club at SGGW. We build the apps the campus uses.

hero.title: The computer science club at SGGW.
hero.lead: The apps people use around campus are written by students at your faculty. You could build the next one with us.

steps.heading: How it works

items.title: Join the Discord
items.body: The whole club lives on the Discord: projects, people, meetup dates. Say a few words about yourself and what you'd like to work on.

items.title: Pick a project or pitch your own
items.body: Get into something that's already running, or bring an idea of your own. Solo or with a few people.

items.title: Work on it over a semester
items.body: On your own or in a small team, at your own pace. And when it helps to sit down together, we meet in room 3/79.

steps.hackathons: We go to hackathons too. HackArena 3.0, March 2026: 4th place in the final.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.lead: Two of our apps are in the stores with over a thousand downloads each. The rest is on GitHub.

build.heading: What we build, and how
build.what: Some of what we build fixes problems we run into at university ourselves. That's where the timetable app and the campus map came from. The rest happens because someone wanted to try a new technology, or do something familiar their own way.
build.how: We don't have one stack. We pick the tools that fit the project, and we're happy to try new ones, sometimes before anyone calls them stable.

join.heading: Join
join.lead: Ever got a script for class, a website or a bot to work? Then you have the basics, and you'll learn the rest in a team!
join.threshold: Join the Discord, introduce yourself, pick a project. That's where we post the in-person meetups too.
join.stripProjects: We build this kind of thing solo or in small teams. Pick a project that's running, or bring your own.
join.stripHistory: The list is still growing. What we're building now, and when we meet, is on the Discord.
